questions.question: What instruction about generosity/risk does Ecclesiastes 11 give?
options: Keep all of your bread for yourself alone, for the times are evil
Give only to those people who are well able to repay you in kind
Cast your bread upon the waters, for you will find it after many days
Store up all of your grain in barns against the coming time of famine
questions.answer: Cast your bread upon the waters, for you will find it after many days

questions.question: What does Ecclesiastes 11 tell the young man to do?
options: Deny himself every pleasure entirely until he reaches a great old age
Rejoice in his youth, but know that God will bring him into judgment
Store up all his wisdom now and put off every joy until much later
Follow his own heart freely, for there is no coming judgment to fear
questions.answer: Rejoice in his youth, but know that God will bring him into judgment
